name: Exp_Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA implements the Hans Indicator Cloud System, a multi-timeframe trading strategy that uses Ichimoku-style cloud analysis across different timeframes to identify trend direction and entry points. It incorporates a time manager (Tm) module for session-based trading and a Plus module for additional signal filtering, making trading decisions based on cloud breakouts and price-cloud interactions.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了Hans指标云系统，一种基于多周期Ichimoku风格云图分析的交易策略，通过不同时间周期的云图判断趋势方向和入场时机。它集成了时间管理器(Tm)模块用于时段交易控制，以及Plus模块用于额外信号过滤，基于云图突破和价格与云图的关系做出交易决策。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Hans指标云系统，这是一种改良的Ichimoku云图方法，通过多条移位均线构建支撑阻力云带来判断趋势。入场条件：当价格从云图下方突破云带上沿时做多，从云图上方跌破云带下沿时做空；同时结合多周期确认，要求更高时间周期趋势方向一致才入场。出场条件包括价格反向穿越云图、止损止盈触发、以及时间管理器强制平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置和最大持仓控制，但具体的资金管理严谨程度取决于参数配置。时间管理器模块允许用户指定交易时段，避免在低流动性或高波动时段开仓。Plus模块提供额外的信号过滤，减少假突破带来的亏损交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Hans Indicator Cloud System, which is a modified Ichimoku cloud approach that constructs support-resistance cloud bands using multiple shifted moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: go long when price breaks above the upper cloud band from below, and go short when price breaks below the lower cloud band from above; multi-timeframe confirmation is required, meaning the higher timeframe trend must align with the entry direction. Exit conditions include price crossing back through the cloud in the opposite direction, stop-loss or take-profit being hit, and forced closure by the time manager module. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity. Money management features include stop-loss settings and maximum position controls, though the rigor of money management depends on parameter configuration. The Time Manager module allows users to specify trading sessions, avoiding opening positions during low-liquidity or high-volatility periods. The Plus module provides additional signal filtering to reduce losing trades caused by false breakouts.

pros: 多周期云图确认机制有效降低假突破风险，提高入场信号质量
时段交易控制避免了低流动性和高波动时段的不利交易
Plus模块的额外信号过滤进一步筛选交易机会，提升胜率
云图系统直观展示支撑阻力区域，便于理解和优化策略逻辑
支持固定手数和动态资金管理两种仓位模式，灵活适应不同账户规模
pros_en: Multi-timeframe cloud confirmation effectively reduces false breakout risk and improves entry signal quality
Session-based trading control avoids unfavorable trades during low-liquidity and high-volatility periods
Plus module's additional signal filtering further screens trading opportunities, improving win rate
Cloud system visually displays support-resistance zones, making strategy logic easy to understand and optimize
Supports both fixed lot and dynamic money management position sizing, flexibly adapting to different account sizes
cons: 云图系统参数较多(周期、偏移量等)，优化不当容易导致过度拟合
依赖趋势行情表现良好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假突破信号
追踪止损默认关闭，缺乏对盈利仓位的动态保护机制
多周期确认可能导致入场延迟，错过趋势初期的最佳入场点
没有包含点差过滤，在高点差时段可能产生不利入场
cons_en: Cloud system has many parameters (periods, shifts, etc.) and improper optimization can easily lead to overfitting
Relies on trending markets for good performance but may generate frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets
Trailing stop is disabled by default, lacking dynamic protection for profitable positions
Multi-timeframe confirmation may cause delayed entries, missing optimal entry points at trend inception
No spread filter included, potentially resulting in unfavorable entries during high-spread periods
improvements: 增加自适应云图参数机制，根据市场波动率动态调整周期和偏移量
加入点差过滤和滑点保护，确保在交易成本过高时禁止开仓
实现动态追踪止损默认开启，基于ATR或云图宽度自动调整止损距离
improvements_en: Add adaptive cloud parameters that dynamically adjust periods and shifts based on market volatility
Implement spread filter and slippage protection to prevent opening positions when trading costs are too high
Enable dynamic trailing stop by default, automatically adjusting stop distance based on ATR or cloud width

risk_points: 多周期云图策略在震荡市中可能连续止损，造成资金回撤
默认追踪止损关闭，盈利仓位缺乏保护可能由盈转亏
缺乏点差过滤在高成本交易环境下可能侵蚀利润
参数过多存在过度拟合风险，回测表现可能优于实盘
risk_points_en: Multi-timeframe cloud strategy may experience consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets, causing drawdown
Trailing stop disabled by default means profitable positions lack protection and may reverse to losses
Lack of spread filter may erode profits in high-cost trading environments
Excessive parameters carry overfitting risk where backtest performance may exceed live trading results
